apply_rotation_transform: apply a Hadamard rotation transform to a PyTorch model using the auto_round library
apply_rotation_transform_weight: apply a Hadamard rotation to model weights using the auto_round rotation transform
apply_rotation_transform_input: apply a Hadamard rotation to model inputs using the auto_round rotation transform
apply_rotation_transform_config: apply a Hadamard rotation to a model with a custom RotationConfig dictionary
apply_rotation_transform_noop: apply a no-op rotation transform to a model by passing None as the config
